title: BioIVT: a Therapy status question after Therapy Outcome
description: Adds a Therapy status question (ongoing, completed, discontinued, unknown, other) right after the original Therapy Outcome question. Step 1 of the ordered therapy chain.
rationale: The real Therapy Outcome answers mix status words (ongoing 15%, completed) with response words; status gets its own question.
source: BioIVT Option C update; approved by Dan

history.note: Stage group and therapy outcome update.
